label: 商团护运员
identityFromAudit: Brown-haired woman with bun, teal scarf and blue-gray coat under brown scale vest. Round wooden shield at screen-right; sheathed short blade/handle at screen-left hip, keys/tags and rope at belt.

independentVisualAudit.appearance: Adult light-tan woman; brown swept hair in low braided bun; serious face; no hat.
independentVisualAudit.costume: Dark teal scarf, blue-gray coat, cream cuffs and divided hem, brown scale vest, brown belt with rectangular brass buckle, short brown trousers, brown boots.
independentVisualAudit.props: Round wooden shield at screen-right, gray metal rim and central boss; sheathed short blade at screen-left hip; rope, brass keys, blank tan tags at belt.
independentVisualAudit.symbolPolicy: No added heraldry or markings. Tags blank. Brass key remains functional key with round bow, long shaft and small tooth.
independentVisualAudit.anatomy: Two arms and hands: near hand over blade belt; far grip obscured behind shield.
